description: Technical Track A: Interactive SDE Problem Solving & Graph Topologies

prompts.statement: There are a total of numCourses courses you have to take, labeled from 0 to numCourses - 1. You are given an array prerequisites where prerequisites[i] = [a_i, b_i] indicates that you must take course b_i first if you want to take course a_i. Return true if you can finish all courses, or false otherwise.
constraints: All prerequisite pairs [a_i, b_i] are unique
Expected O(V + E) time and O(V + E) space

examples.explanation: Direct cycle between 0 and 1; neither course can be completed.

clarificationBranches.question: Are duplicate edges or self-loops possible in prerequisites?
clarificationBranches.answer: All pairs are unique, but self-loops like [0, 0] may be present in input and immediately constitute a cycle.

followups.question: How would you modify your algorithm to return an actual topological ordering of the courses, rather than just a boolean?
followups.criterion: Appends nodes with zero indegree to an order list during BFS, returning the list if its length equals numCourses.

privateReference.approach: Model as a directed graph. A valid course schedule exists if and only if the graph is a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). Use Kahn's algorithm (BFS with in-degrees) or 3-state DFS (white/gray/black visited states) to detect cycles.
checks: Handles graphs with no edges (returns true)
privateReference.expectedComplexity: O(V + E) time, O(V + E) space

source.note: Canonical Technical Round A Topological Sort benchmark
